avis.texte: I love this moisturizer so much! My friend got it for me for my birthday and now I've ran out so I'm going to buy it again! It's so worth the money and it leave my face feeling clean and soft before bed at night. If you have the money for this I would definitely recommend buying it!
It's so hard to find hydration for your face that doesn't just sit on the face but actually absorbs. This is awesome! It's so cheap too. I bought so many jars in fear it would discontinue.
I've been using this as my main moisturizer for years. I've gotten over 10 jars of it. It's much more helpful in the winter when I'm really dry but it's great all year round.

Bought this after reading the reviews, and I'm glad I did. I struggle finding a moisturizer that doesn't leave me greasy, which results in me not using it nearly as often as I should. not this one. For my first use, I only used what little bit was on the plastic guard - and it was enough to cover my whole face, leave me moisturized, and not greasy! I had a couple dry spots, and it's like they literally vanished! smells great, too. highly recommend this product

I got this mask on a whim to share with my boyfriend last winter, thinking it was more of a face mask than jelly moisturizer. It was not a winner for me personally, but my boyfriend absolutely loved it and actually used up 3 jars since. It makes my face a bit too oily and the fragrance is a lot for me. Maybe it's so good for him because it hydrates his stubbly facial hair too, seriously making him SHINE. Haven't been able to find it in store for a few months, but I'm hoping I can nab some for him soon!

This is the only moisturizer that I use daily. I also really love the strawberry scent of the mask; it's not strong, but it's sweet.
I love the texture, the scent, all of it! Just makes my cheeks break out and turn red! Heart broken!
